2.applies_to: user-scores.json schema_version 2 (v0.6.7 and v0.6.8), carried to schema 3
2.rule: A level L at or below 2 is unchanged (levels 1 and 2 are the panel minimum and median, as before). A level above 2 becomes 2 + (L - 2) * (A - 2), A being the level the old level 3 (the anchor claude-opus-5-5) has on the facet scale of the version named in `source`; the segment above 3 continues with the same slope. A category entry of several facets (coding, tool_operation) above 2 is written per facet. Converted levels are written to 2 decimals.

source.statement: v0.7.0 references/five-axis-scores.json (schema agent-compass.five-axis-scores/6): `anchor_levels` is the level of z = 0 on each facet scale (t1, t2, t3 = panel minimum, median, maximum, listed under `scale`). They are frozen here so that a local file upgraded on any later version gets the same levels.
source.note: tool_operation.responsiveness: the scale of schema 2 had t2 = t3 (the anchor sat at or below the panel median), so every level above 2 meant the panel median; its anchor level is 2.0 by that definition, not read from the scale.
